title: Constant local fibre dimension near one Cohen-Macaulay fibre stalk
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U an open of T such that f restricted over U is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and W an open of X. Let y∈W with f(y)∈U. Suppose the depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of the fibre local ring at y [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There exist n∈ℕ and an open O of X with y∈O⊆W such that every z∈O has local topological fibre dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] n. No Cohen-Macaulay assumption is imposed away from y; no partition is asserted.

source.place: Tag 00RH (Lemma 10.130.4), its proof using 00QE, 00RE, 00R7, 00RC; Tag 0A21 (10); local step underlying 02NM

proof.text: Construct a flat locally quasi-finite locally finitely presented chart h:V→P containing y, with g:P→T smooth of some fixed relative dimension n and h≫g=V.ι≫f.

For any point z of V, form the map from the fibre of h≫g at its image to the corresponding fibre of g. Pullback cancellation proves this is a base change of h, so it is flat, locally quasi-finite and locally finitely presented. The fibre of g is smooth of relative dimension n over the residue field. The flat quasi-finite smooth local-dimension theorem computes the local dimension of the fibre of h≫g at z as n.

Transport this dimension through the open immersion V→X: use the canonical pullback map between fibres, prove it is an open immersion and sends the canonical fibre point to the original one, and compare infima over open neighbourhoods via inverse images and open images. Take O=V∩W. It contains y, is contained in W, and every point of O has the computed local fibre dimension n.

proof_origin.place: 00RH flat quasi-finite chart construction; proved flat quasi-finite coheight invariance and smooth fixed-dimension theorem, followed by pullback and open-fibre transport in Lean.

theorem exists_constant_fibre_dimension_neighbourhood_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] (W : X.Opens)
    (y : X) (hy : y ∈ W) (ht : f y ∈ U)
    (hdepth :
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (O : X.Opens), y ∈ O ∧ O ≤ W ∧
      ∀ z ∈ O, topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber z) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
